description: The ellipsis also cuts a line of text mixed with inline elements.

florui.css: .p { width: 90px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .b { font-weight: 700; background-color: #ffd54a; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 6.58% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 17.54% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
